description: ADRENALIN - Multi-National Time-Series Dataset of Sub-Metered Building Energy Use is published by Bengtsson, Gustaf Viktor; Amos, Matthew; Gomez Garcia, Rafael; Lien, Synne Krekling. It describes sub-metered building-energy time series from multiple countries, intended for disaggregation, demand response and control benchmarking. Spatial scope is regional (Multiple countries; exact country list not stated in the inspected description). Spatial detail: Individual buildings and meters. The full data period remains unverified. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists CSV, ZIP; these files were not downloaded. Licence: cc-by-4.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The deposit combines multiple building sites and countries, not continuous regional coverage. The exact country list and full observation periods require the linked documentation. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus.
